cis_trans_wide.drawn.svg.title: Cis and trans arrangements of linked w and m loci
cis_trans_wide.drawn.svg.description: Each panel shows a homologous pair schematically, with one rod per homolog. Cis has w m together and + + together; trans has w + and + m. Gene positions match between homologs. Colors track homolog identity, not dominance. No replication or crossover is depicted.

cis_trans_portrait.drawn.svg.title: Cis and trans arrangements in a narrow panel
cis_trans_portrait.drawn.svg.description: Two homologs in each arrangement; w m and + + in cis, w + and + m in trans. Homolog identity uses blue and orange. The view is schematic, with no replication or crossing over.
